stories.title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies aged 65
stories.summary: The musician, who co-wrote some of the band's biggest hits, had been treated for prostate cancer.

stories.title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
stories.summary: The discount chain has fallen into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer.

stories.title: Man and daughter who dumped murdered woman in canal jailed
stories.summary: Chereiss Bailey was killed by John Anslow who then, along with his daughter, tried to hide the body.

stories.title: Bake Off finalist inspired to take new chances

stories.title: MP wants one train every 15 minutes between Birmingham and Telford
stories.summary: Labour MP Shaun Davies tells the government a better rail service for Telford will boost investment.

stories.title: Women guilty of running illegal 28-pupil school

stories.title: Council leader told to resign in row over behaviour

stories.title: Chemotherapy error 'robbed grandad of final months'

stories.summary: Cast members will be protesting with actors union Equity to ask fans to back their campaign

stories.title: 'Help us keep chimps cosy this winter', says zoo
stories.summary: Primates at Dudley Zoo and Castle need unwanted bedding to line their nests.
